title: Matcap Shader Editor with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a Three.js matcap shader editor that allows users to create, edit, and apply custom matcap textures to 3D objects with full undo/redo support.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use Three.js (import from CDN)
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 0, 4), FOV 60
- Scene background: #1a1a2e
- Display 3 meshes in a row (x positions: -2, 0, 2): a TorusKnot (left), a Sphere (center), an Icosahedron (right)
- Each mesh uses a custom ShaderMaterial implementing matcap shading
- The matcap texture is procedurally generated on a 256x256 canvas
- OrbitControls for camera rotation

MATCAP TEXTURE GENERATION:
- Generate matcap textures procedurally using a 256x256 offscreen canvas
- The matcap is defined by 4 parameters:
  * baseColor: hex color string (default '#4488ff')
  * highlightColor: hex color string (default '#ffffff')
  * highlightSize: float 0.1-0.9 (default 0.3)
  * rimColor: hex color string (default '#001133')
- The matcap is rendered as concentric radial gradients from center (highlight) to edge (rim)
- The shader must use view-space normals to sample the matcap texture

CUSTOM SHADER:
- Vertex shader: transform normals to view space, pass UV-like matcap coordinates
- Fragment shader: sample the matcap texture using view-space normal mapped to 0-1 range
- matcapUV = viewNormal.xy * 0.5 + 0.5

UI PANEL (DOM overlay, top-left, 300px wide):
- Title: 'Matcap Editor'
- Color inputs: 'Base Color', 'Highlight Color', 'Rim Color' (HTML color pickers)
- Range slider: 'Highlight Size' (min 0.1, max 0.9, step 0.01)
- Dropdown select: 'Active Mesh' with options 'TorusKnot', 'Sphere', 'Icosahedron'
- Button: 'Apply to Selected' (id='btn-apply')
- Button: 'Apply to All' (id='btn-apply-all')
- Button: 'Undo' (id='btn-undo')
- Button: 'Redo' (id='btn-redo')
- Button: 'Reset All' (id='btn-reset')
- Display div showing current undo stack depth (id='stack-depth')
- Matcap preview canvas (128x128, id='matcap-preview') showing current matcap

UNDO/REDO SYSTEM:
- Maintain an undo stack (max 20 entries) and redo stack
- Each entry stores: { meshIndex, previousParams, newParams } where params = {baseColor, highlightColor, highlightSize, rimColor}
- 'Apply to Selected' pushes one entry for the selected mesh
- 'Apply to All' pushes 3 entries (one per mesh) as a single group action
- Undo reverts the last action (or group), Redo re-applies
- Keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl+Z = Undo, Ctrl+Y = Redo
- 'Reset All' clears both stacks and resets all meshes to default params

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
- meshParams: array of 3 objects, each with {baseColor, highlightColor, highlightSize, rimColor}
- activeMeshIndex: integer 0-2
- editorParams: {baseColor, highlightColor, highlightSize, rimColor} (current editor values)
- undoStackSize: number
- redoStackSize: number
- lastAction: string ('none'|'apply_single'|'apply_all'|'undo'|'redo'|'reset')
- matcapTextureValid: boolean (true if texture generated without error)
- meshCount: 3
- frameCount: incrementing integer
- cameraDistance: float (distance from origin)

ANIMATION:
- Meshes rotate slowly on Y axis (0.005 rad/frame)
- Update state every frame in the render loop
- Ensure frameCount increments each frame
physics_constraints: Matcap UV coordinates must be derived from view-space normals mapped to [0,1] range. Highlight size controls gradient falloff radius. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous shader parameters with zero drift. Stack depth must never exceed 20.
